scope: An application form with no bridge area, described by the native plugin alone: matched to the project's form definition from its object layers, its buttons, named by their titles, help tips, object names or picture files, captions, inputs labelled by captions, checkboxes and radio buttons with drawn states, drop-down lists, tab controls by their drawn labels, and list boxes as tables of their visible rows, named by their caption or object name, with the column titles 4D draws, and page subforms' own forms, including components' such as 4D Widgets', published in reading order with 4D's keyboard focus, on buttons too, as the focused element and operated with ordinary clicks and keys; by AX and by VoiceOver
fixture: prepare_generic_form_fixture.py and test_generic_form_fixture.py (Customer form without a bridge area, with a collection list box whose Amount column the form renames Total when it loads, a tab control going to two pages, a page subform and 4D Widgets' search picker)
checks: the form is pixel-identical to the plugin-free form
the form's labelled objects are published in reading order; a button with 4D's default name and an invisible button are not
inputs are labelled by their captions, with their values and placeholders
the checkbox and radio buttons are published with their drawn states
the drop-down shows its value; an untitled button is labelled by its help tip, or else by its object name
a list box is a table labelled by its caption, with the column titles 4D draws, one renamed at load, and its visible rows' cells
Tab and Shift-Tab move the application's focused element with 4D's focus, through fields, checkboxes, radio buttons and a drop-down
Tab moves the focused element to buttons, which 4D draws without a focus ring
writing an input's value types it into 4D's own field
pressing the checkbox runs its On Clicked and checks it
pressing a radio button chooses it and clears the other
the drop-down opens 4D's native menu, and choosing an item changes its value
pressing a row selects it through the list box's own handling, and the table reports it selected
a page subform's own objects are published in its place, and operated within it
4D Widgets' search picker, from 4D's own component, is a text field labelled Search, beside its Search options button
pressing Save runs its method, which reads every value set through accessibility
a tab control's tabs are radio buttons named by their drawn labels; the current page's is chosen
pressing a tab shows its page through the tab control's own action, and the tab is chosen
a list box without a caption is a table named by the words of its object name
every event belongs to this run
Done closes the form through its standard action
VoiceOver reaches the form
VoiceOver reads the Name field by its caption
keys typed at the field enter it in 4D's own field
VoiceOver follows 4D's focus to the next field when Tab moves it
VoiceOver reads the checkbox and its state
VO-Space checks the checkbox through its own handling
VoiceOver follows 4D's focus to a button when Tab moves it
VoiceOver reaches Save
VoiceOver reads the list box as a table labelled by its caption
interacting with it reads the first row's cell with its column title
VO-Down moves to the next row
the row VoiceOver reaches is selected once, through the list box's own handling
VoiceOver returns to Save past the button named by its object name
VO-Space runs Save, which reads the form's values
VoiceOver reads a tab by its drawn label
VO-Space on a tab shows its page, and the tab is chosen
VoiceOver reads a list box without a caption by its object's name
voiceOverSpeech: 4D AX bridge generic form window Customer details has keyboard focus
symphonyProbe: With the plugin alone, Symphony's unintegrated Manufacturers window (TableForms/46/ManufacturerAbbv_Browser) was matched among 1993 indexed forms. Its buttons and captions, and its three list boxes as tables, were published. The main list box, whose columns the application hides and resizes at run time, showed all 21 visible rows with each cell in its drawn column; five column titles matched their defined widths and three resized columns were left unnamed. Not an acceptance record. With component forms indexed, the window's 4D Widgets search picker was published as a text field labelled Search; writing "Able" through accessibility filtered the manufacturers list through the application's own search.
notCovered: List box rows beyond those drawn, and cell editing
Tab controls, list subforms, pictures, hierarchical lists, web and plugin areas
Picture buttons, group boxes and combo boxes (implemented without acceptance)
Reporting the keyboard focus 4D gives a field
4D Widgets' date button, date entry and time pickers (named without acceptance)
